title: Orsen and the Archive
author: Kestrel Dravenmoor
blurb: Paloma Crane, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
